# HA Wall Kiosks

**Fleet:** basement / entryway / upstairs Raspberry Pi wall Chromium → HA `main-dashboard`.

**Signals:** Telegraf OTLP metrics + remediator OTEL logs → `dt02.lindleyhome.com:4319` → Grail. Tags: `scope=ha_kiosk`, `fleet=wall_dashboards`.

**Alerts:** Davis detectors (`CUSTOM_ALERT`, `scope=ha_kiosk`) + HTTP synthetic [Home Assistant UI](https://oei3894h.sprint.apps.dynatracelabs.com/ui/apps/dynatrace.syntheticClassic/ui/http-monitor/HTTP_CHECK-B7E7A1709EC9D9AB) create Problems (not the deactivated workflow).

→ **Full operator runbook is the markdown tile at the bottom of this dashboard.**

1.query:
timeseries mem = avg(mem_used_percent), by:{host.name}, interval:1m
| filter in(host.name, {"basement-dashboard","entryway-dashboard","upstairs-dashboard"})
1.title: Memory used %

2.query:
timeseries swap = avg(swap_used_percent), by:{host.name}, interval:1m
| filter in(host.name, {"basement-dashboard","entryway-dashboard","upstairs-dashboard"})
2.title: Swap used %

3.query:
timeseries wifi = avg(wireless_level), by:{host.name, interface}, interval:1m
| filter in(host.name, {"basement-dashboard","entryway-dashboard","upstairs-dashboard"})
3.title: Wi-Fi signal (dBm)

4.query:
timeseries n = avg(procstat_lookup_pid_count), by:{host.name, role_detail}, interval:1m
| filter role_detail == "procstat_chromium"
| filter in(host.name, {"basement-dashboard","entryway-dashboard","upstairs-dashboard"})
4.title: Chromium pid_count

5.query:
timeseries user = avg(cpu_usage_user), by:{host.name}, interval:1m
| filter in(host.name, {"basement-dashboard","entryway-dashboard","upstairs-dashboard"})
5.title: CPU usage user %

6.query:
fetch logs
| filter in(host.name, {"basement-dashboard","entryway-dashboard","upstairs-dashboard"})
| filter contains(content, "\"component\":\"kiosk-remediator\"")
| fields timestamp, host.name, content
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 50
6.title: Remediator events (JSON only)

7.query:
fetch events
| filter startsWith(event.name, "HA Kiosk")
| sort timestamp desc
| fields timestamp, event.name, event.status, event.kind, event.description
| limit 40
7.title: HA Kiosk problems / alerts

8.query:
timeseries d = avg(disk_used_percent), by:{host.name, path}, interval:1m
| filter path == "/"
| filter in(host.name, {"basement-dashboard","entryway-dashboard","upstairs-dashboard"})
8.title: Disk used % (/)

9.query:
timeseries avail = avg(dt.synthetic.http.availability), by:{dt.entity.http_check}, interval:1m
| filter dt.entity.http_check == "HTTP_CHECK-B7E7A1709EC9D9AB"
9.title: HA UI HTTP synthetic availability

10.query:
fetch events
| filter event.kind == "DAVIS_PROBLEM"
| filter startsWith(event.name, "HA Kiosk")
| filter event.status == "ACTIVE"
| summarize c = count(), by:{event.name}
| sort c desc
10.title: ACTIVE HA Kiosk problems

11.query:
timeseries rss = avg(procstat_memory_rss), by:{host.name, role_detail}, interval:1m
| filter role_detail == "procstat_chromium"
| filter in(host.name, {"basement-dashboard","entryway-dashboard","upstairs-dashboard"})
11.title: Chromium RSS (bytes)

12.query:
timeseries t = avg(sensors_temp_input), by:{host.name, chip, feature}, interval:1m
| filter chip == "cpu_thermal-virtual-0"
| filter in(host.name, {"basement-dashboard","entryway-dashboard","upstairs-dashboard"})
12.title: SoC temp °C (cpu_thermal)

# Operator runbook — HA Wall Kiosks

Use this when diagnosing blank tiles, OTEL not reaching Dynatrace, kiosk performance, remediator behavior, or HA UI outages. Written for “me in 2 months.”

## 1. What this is

- Three Raspberry Pi 3 wall kiosks running Chromium fullscreen against Home Assistant Lovelace.
- Kiosk URL: `http://automation.lindleyhome.com:8123/lovelace-dashboards/main-dashboard`
- Ansible inventory (ansible20): group `hass_dashboard_servers` + `otel_observed` with tags `role=ha_kiosk`, `fleet=wall_dashboards`
- Configure playbook: `playbooks_installs/dashboards-configure_home_automation.yml` (remediator timer **120s**, zramswap, DevTools `--remote-allow-origins=*`)
- Telegraf playbook: `playbooks_base/telegraf-install_and_manage.yml` → OTLP exporter to `dt02.lindleyhome.com:4319`
- Dashboard document ID: `46082379-e46e-46e9-a304-7706e309cbf6` (this dashboard)

## 2. Hosts in scope

- `basement-dashboard` — wall kiosk
- `entryway-dashboard` — wall kiosk (**often weakest Wi‑Fi**)
- `upstairs-dashboard` — wall kiosk
- **Out of scope:** `kitchen-dashboard` (not in this fleet / not on these tiles)

Tile DQL hardcodes:
`filter in(host.name, {"basement-dashboard","entryway-dashboard","upstairs-dashboard"})`
Do **not** reintroduce a dashboard `$host` CSV variable with empty default — that previously blanked all tiles (“No records”).

## 3. Signal path

```
kiosk Telegraf (host metrics + procstat chromium)
  + otelcol-agent-logs (remediator JSONL / journal)
      → dt02.lindleyhome.com:4319
      → Dynatrace Grail
Davis anomaly detectors (CUSTOM_ALERT) + HTTP synthetic
      → Problems (near real-time)
```

- OpenPipeline route **`ha-kiosk-remediator`** parses remediator JSON into fields like `kiosk.check`, `kiosk.result`, `kiosk.action`, `kiosk.action_result`.
- Influx / `dt-influx` path is **not** used (`telegraf_influx_mode: none`). Do not chase classic Influx for this fleet.

## 4. Metric keys on this dashboard

- Memory / swap / CPU: `mem_used_percent`, `swap_used_percent`, `cpu_usage_user`
- Wi‑Fi: `wireless_level` (dBm; more negative = weaker)
- Chromium process: `procstat_lookup_pid_count`, `procstat_memory_rss` with `role_detail=procstat_chromium`
- Disk: `disk_used_percent` for path `/`
- SoC temp: `sensors_temp_input` where `chip == "cpu_thermal-virtual-0"` (lm-sensors). **Not** `pi_temp` — telegraf user cannot run `vcgencmd`.
- Synthetic availability: `dt.synthetic.http.availability` for monitor `HTTP_CHECK-B7E7A1709EC9D9AB`

## 5. Davis detectors (`scope=ha_kiosk`)

These open Problems (Grail / event tiles on this dashboard). Classic Problems UI may not list them the same way.

- **High memory** — ABOVE **85**, 5 of 10
- **High swap** — ABOVE **60**, 5 of 10
- **Wi‑Fi weak** — BELOW **−78** dBm, 3 of 5, alert on missing data
- **Chromium missing** — BELOW **1** pid_count, 5 of 10, **no** alert on missing data
- **Metrics silent** — missing `mem_used_percent`, 3 of 5, missing-data alert
- **Remediator failure** — `action_result` fail count ABOVE **0**, 2 of 5
- **Chromium restart storm** — elevated restarts, 4 of 10
- **HA root unreachable** — remediator `ha_root` fail, 2 of 5

## 6. HTTP synthetic

- Name: **Home Assistant UI**
- ID: `HTTP_CHECK-B7E7A1709EC9D9AB`
- URL: `http://automation.lindleyhome.com:8123/`
- Location: private **`lindleyhome-home`**
- Frequency: **1 minute**; global outage after **2 consecutive** failures
- UI: [open synthetic](https://oei3894h.sprint.apps.dynatracelabs.com/ui/apps/dynatrace.syntheticClassic/ui/http-monitor/HTTP_CHECK-B7E7A1709EC9D9AB)

This is HA reachability from the private location — not per-kiosk browser health.

## 7. HA / remediator side (on each Pi)

- Remediator is **network-first**: check HA root + gateway before treating Chromium as broken.
- Never restart Chromium while network/HA root is down.
- After network OK: dashboard HTTP + DevTools checks; Chromium restart after **3 consecutive** browser failures.
- Logs: `/var/log/kiosk/events.jsonl` and `logger -t kiosk-remediator` (journal)
- Stable JSON fields: `component`, `phase`, `check`, `result`, `action`, `action_result`
- Key units: `chromium-browser`, `kiosk-remediator.timer` (120s), `telegraf`, `otelcol-agent-logs`, `zramswap`

## 8. Diagnose in 2 months (decision tree)

**A. Dashboard all empty / “No records”**
1. Confirm tile queries still hardcode the three host names (no empty `$host`).
2. Paste the same DQL into a Notebook with a generous timeframe.
3. Notebook has data → dashboard filter/timeframe issue. Notebook empty → ingestion / host naming.

**B. No metrics from one or all kiosks**
1. From ansible20, SSH the host(s): `systemctl status telegraf`
2. Journal: OTLP timeouts / `DeadlineExceeded` to `dt02:4319`
3. Confirm host still in `otel_observed` and tags `role=ha_kiosk`
4. Detector “metrics silent” / missing mem should fire if silence is real

**C. No remediator logs in Dynatrace**
1. On Pi: `systemctl status otelcol-agent-logs`; tail `/var/log/kiosk/events.jsonl`
2. In Dynatrace: OpenPipeline route `ha-kiosk-remediator` still parsing `kiosk.*` fields
3. Remediator tile on this dashboard filters JSON-only / OpenPipeline fields — raw journal noise may be excluded

**D. Kiosk blank or slow, but metrics look OK**
1. Remediator: `dashboard_http` / DevTools fails vs network OK
2. Chromium RSS + swap % tiles; chronic high swap → consider reclaim / reboot (disk swap vs zram)
3. Lovelace `main-dashboard` weight on Pi 3 (heavy cards)
4. Local: `systemctl status chromium-browser kiosk-remediator.timer`

**E. HA down for everyone**
1. Synthetic **Home Assistant UI** outage
2. Remediator `ha_root` fail on **all three** hosts
3. Not a single-kiosk Chromium issue

**F. One kiosk network / Wi‑Fi**
1. Remediator wifi_bounce / gateway fail on that host only
2. Check Wi‑Fi dBm tile (entryway often weakest, ~−67 dBm historically)
3. Other hosts + synthetic still green → local RF/AP issue

## 9. What not to confuse

- Deactivated workflow **`HA Wall Kiosk Davis Alerts`** (`66138a8d-2f3b-45d0-945a-b1a1c5ad696f`) does **not** create Problems — Davis detectors + synthetic do.
- Ops Explorer / other HTTP synthetics are a **different** product surface from this wall-kiosk fleet.
- Kitchen dashboard is not monitored by these tiles or `scope=ha_kiosk` detectors.
- Env: platform `https://oei3894h.sprint.apps.dynatracelabs.com` (classic sibling `…sprint.dynatracelabs.com` for some synthetic UI paths).
